scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.render-build: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cd desktop && npm run dev"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run build
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run build:win
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run build:mac
